title: There Is a Louder Shout to Come
lyrics: Verse 1:
[E]There is a louder shout to come, [F#m7]there is a sweeter song to hear;
[C#m]All the nations [B]with one [A]voice, [F#m7]all the people [E/G#]with one [B]fear.
[E]Bowing down before Your throne, [F#m7]every tribe and tongue will be;
[C#m]All the nations [B]with one [A]voice, [F#m7]all the people [E/G#]with one [B]King.
And [F#m7]what a song we'll [E/G#]sing upon that [A]day.
Chorus 1:
[E]O what a [F#m7]song we'll [B]sing and [E]O what a [A]tune we'll [B]bear;
[F#m7]You deserve an [G#m7]anthem of the [A]highest praise.
[E]O what a [F#m7]joy will [B]rise and [E]O what a [A]sound we'll [B]make;
[F#m7]You deserve an [G#m7]anthem of the [A]highest praise[E].
Verse 2:
Now we see a part of this, one day we shall see in full;
All the nations with one voice, all the people with one love.
No one else will share Your praise, nothing else can take Your place;
All the nations with one voice, all the people with one Lord.
And what a song we'll sing upon that day.
Verse 3:
Even now upon the earth, there's a glimpse of all to come;
Many people with one voice, harmony of many tongues.
We will all confess Your name, You will be our only praise;
All the nations with one voice, all the people with one God.
And what a song we'll sing upon that day.
